summary: Makes click.Path generic on path_type with a defaulted covariant TypeVar; runtime behavior of coerce_path_result/convert is unchanged and the typing/runtime tests cover the new parameterization. No blocking defects found.

findings.explanation: The input contravariant type is narrowed to str | os.PathLike[str] (previously defaulted to Any), although convert() still handles bytes input (isinstance(rv, bytes) check). Static callers passing bytes to Path.convert/__call__ may now get type errors. Likely acceptable and consistent with the annotated convert signature, but worth noting.
